name: Body Scan Meditation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Lie down or sit comfortably, and let your eyes close gently.
Take a few deep breaths to settle in.
Bring your attention to your feet, noticing any sensations without trying to change them.
Slowly move your attention upward — ankles, legs, hips, torso, arms, and head — pausing briefly at each area.
Finish by taking a deep breath and noticing your body as a whole before opening your eyes.
